item.title: A Sonoma County alternative to Juvenile Hall
item.description: Vista Academy offers court-ordered youth an alternative to Juvenile Hall, keeping them home, in school and busy during the risky after-school hours. Run by Circuit Rider Community Services in partnership with the Sonoma County Probation Department, the program mixes structure, support and wraparound services — including mental health help — aimed at reducing re-arrest and helping young people return to their communities.
